mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS sessionId, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.price, s.language_version AS languageVersion, h.name, h.capacity, h.seat_layout AS seatLayout, h.location FROM session s JOIN hall h ON h.id = s.hall_id WHERE s.movie_id = #{id} AND s.status = 1 ORDER BY s.start_time ASC
